summary: A six-track firmware for sound exploration, free loops and clocked performance, with eight engines and an animated creature drawn for each engine. Based on Tonitor and still at release-candidate stage.
features: Eight engines: FM, ACID, DROPLETS, FRACT, DRUID, RYUJI, HIVE, OBRADOR
Granular processing, filters, modulation and effects; BALLSY, BRICKLAYER, PLAY ALONG modes
RYUJI drums: 10 VA percussion sources plus 38 one-shots, editable kits
Browser simulator runs the firmware code, no FM-1 needed
RC7 confirmed on hardware; RC10 hardware testing still pending
Other firmwares' projects and samples may be overwritten

headings: current prerelease: 1.0 rc10 — ryuji va + samples
